_autoReindex: Watches your library folders and reindexes a presentation moments after you edit it. Set to false to turn it off and reindex by hand from Settings › Search. It never starts a full rebuild on its own, and never reindexes more than 25 changed presentations without being asked.
_protectProPresenter: Protect ProPresenter: ON unless false. While on, Refrain never reads presentations from ProPresenter in bulk: no Quality Control scans, pre-service checks, FS/T lookups or Get slide pictures, and the index runs only from ProPresenter's library files on this computer (see indexFromFiles), never through its API. Without readable files, no index runs and search uses the index already saved. Turned off only in Settings › Search › Advanced.
_indexFromFiles: The search index reads each presentation from its .pro file in ProPresenter's library when ProPresenter runs on this computer, instead of asking ProPresenter for it: an API read makes ProPresenter write to its workspace database (about 13 KB each), a file read writes nothing. ProPresenter is still asked which presentations each library has. Set false to read everything through the API as before. Needs the propresenter-bundle package; without it, or with ProPresenter on another computer, the API is used.
_slidePicturesQuickSlides: Slide pictures are drawn by Refrain from the presentation files on this Mac, which asks nothing of ProPresenter; phones show words. slidePictures.quickSlides: the safe slide keys on Now show the slide drawn, or its name when false. ON unless false. Settings › More › Phones › Slide pictures.
_slidePicturesFlagged: slidePictures.flagged: when Refrain can't draw a flagged slide (ProPresenter on another Mac, or a presentation outside its libraries), ask ProPresenter for a picture of that one slide when the flag is added, kept in data/flag-pictures with the flag, even during performance mode. ON unless false.
_searchLibrariesOff: Search's own choices, set on the Search screen and kept on this machine. searchLibrariesOff is the libraries switched off there (a library added later is searched); searchDateField (modified or created) is still saved, but the Search screen no longer has a date filter.
_features: Settings › Features: which screens and tools are on. Search and Quality Control (with its date checks) are always on. Leave a feature out to get its default; true or false is a choice and wins. Defaults: slide-flags, service and messages on; safe-slides, requests (staff requests from the announcement app), macros, looks, qr-code, image-crop, arrangement, lyrics-assist, scripture and probundle (Bundles) off, so the Prep key appears only once a prep tool is on. Off hides the screen and its routes answer "switched off". messages covers Now's ProPresenter messages and stage messages, and the phone's Alert tab; slide-flags covers the phone's Flag tab. The older arrangementModule.enabled, imageCropModule.enabled and serviceModule.enabled are no longer read.
_probundleModule: Bundles (Settings › Features › Bundles): packsDir is the folder for your church's own templates, under ./data (the default ./data/probundle-packs) or outside Refrain's folder, never elsewhere in it. The screen is misconfigured until it is set and exists.
_slideFlagsModule: Where Flag this slide keeps its flags. Leave folder null to keep them on this machine only. Point it at a folder two machines can both see (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive) to share one list; each flag is its own file, so they never overwrite each other. Optional: types replaces the problem-type list (each {"label", "icon"}, icon a Lucide name); keepResolvedDays is how long a resolved flag stays on the Flags screen (default 14, never deleted).
_liveModule: Service › Now choices. hiddenMacros is the ProPresenter macro ids the church has put away with Edit on the Macros heading; they stay in ProPresenter and can be brought back from the same place. safeSlides is up to 4 known-good slides (a logo, a blank, a standing announcement; a list saved when eight were allowed is still read whole) kept with Keep current at the foot of Service › Now (switched on in Settings › Features); each is stored by the slide's anchor, and refuses to fire if the presentation no longer has that slide. No message codes are remembered: a code is random each time, so nothing keeps a list of them. hiddenMessages is the ProPresenter message ids put away with Edit on the Messages heading (left off Now and the phone); they stay in ProPresenter and can be brought back from the same place. stageMessages is the stage message presets, edited on Now; absent means the three defaults. requestMessageId is the ProPresenter message id that Staff requests post into when more than one message has a text field; absent means the first one not put away.
_networkModule: Phone flags and the service progress feed (off until enabled). A separate listener on its own port that anyone on the church network can open on a phone: it shows what's live, the last few slides and where the service is, and adds a flag with a note and a name. It shows slides as words (a flag's card shows a picture only when ProPresenter had to give one, for a slide the booth can't draw), sends stage messages and pager codes from phones the booth approved and puts a slide on the screens only if phoneGoLive is on. Refrain's main screens stay on this machine only. pin is "daily" (a four-digit PIN that changes at midnight, shown in the booth in the Phone panel and on the Flags screen), a fixed 4 to 8 digits, or empty for none. pinHint is what the phone's PIN screen says about where to find it. A correct PIN signs the phone in until midnight, or for 30 days if the person ticks "Trust this phone"; Sign out all phones, in the Phone panel, signs them all out. phoneGoLive is false: no phone can put a slide on the screens. Turn it on in the Phone panel ("Let phones go live"): a phone then needs this month's four-digit device code (shown only in that panel) once a month, and for every go-live a fresh code the phone shows and the person types, then a separate confirm. Each one is logged with the phone's name, and switching it off stops phones at once. host defaults to every network address (0.0.0.0); set 127.0.0.1 to try it on this machine only.
_reportModule: Sending End's day summary somewhere (off until enabled). deliveryBackend is a file in delivery/: email (SMTP settings in .env, recipients here) or folder (folder here). A person presses Send after reading the summary unless requireReview is false. Email sends the summary off this machine; it only happens for a church that turns this on.
_serviceModule: Service › Day: a timing rundown of what went live in each service, and lock-in for live events. Switched with features.service. Everything else is optional. schedule lists recurring services in this machine's local time, e.g. [{"day": "sun", "time": "09:00", "name": "Early", "playlistMatch": "early"}]; playlistMatch picks the playlist whose name contains it. Refrain watches closely from leadMinutes before a start to trailMinutes after. folder works like slideFlagsModule.folder: one file per event, safe in a synced folder. playlistMatch plus today's date picks this week's playlist (6/7/26, 06/07/26, Jun-07-26, Jun 7 and 2026-06-07 are all recognised). summaryFolder, if set, gets a copy of each day summary End writes (a new file every time, never an overwrite). phases replaces the checklist: [{"name": "Arrive", "scope": "day", "steps": ["Screens on", {"label": "Run the checks", "checks": true}]}], where scope is day, service (once per service) or between (after every service but the last), and a step with end: true ticks when the day is ended. Leave it null for the default.
_serviceModuleAutoEnd: serviceModule.autoEnd: End the day on its own and send the summary (Settings › Features › Day summary). Off unless enabled. Ends after idleMinutes with nothing on the screens (15 to 1440, default 120), or after ProPresenter has been closed for closedMinutes on this Mac (5 to 360, default 15), whichever comes first; never on a day nothing went live, before a service still scheduled today, during a lock-in or performance mode, and at most once a day. Sends straight away when reportModule is set up; nobody reviews it first.
_serviceFeedModule: Lets this console report to your own announcement server: which slide is showing, and its diagnostics log afterwards (see docs/service-feed.md). Off until enabled, and it only ever talks to the url you set: nothing goes to the Refrain project. url is the console address from the announcement server's admin page (https). Set these on the Telemetry tab of Settings. name is the station's name as the announcement server lists it (for example Main Campus FOH). The key goes in .env as SERVICE_FEED_TOKEN. includeSlideText sends the words on the slide as well as its title and number; leave it false unless you want that. windows are the only times it sends status, in this machine's local time. nightlyLog sends the diagnostics log each night at nightlyLogAt (local time, default 02:00), only the days the server does not have yet, never inside a window or during performance mode; false means only when someone presses Send log. consoleId is filled in by Refrain.
